name: Creeper Ichor
summary: Creeper Ichor is a rare, virulent fluid harvested from the moss creepers lurking throughout the forests of the Hillsbrad Foothills. It is sought by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill as a potent biological agent for formulating novel plagues against the living.

sections.title: Apothecary Research in Hillsbrad
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon conducts experiments to craft deadly new toxins, seeking to eradicate the surrounding human population. Despising the clean air and vibrant life of the foothills, Lydon searches for natural toxins and biological catalysts native to the local wildlife. The venomous fluids of the forest's giant arachnids, particularly the elusive ichor found within mature moss creepers, serve as an ideal base for his Elixir of Suffering. Mixed with other reagents like gray bear tongues, this fluid aids the Forsaken in perfecting their craft of lethal alchemy.

faq.answer: The fluid is harvested from moss creepers inhabiting the Hillsbrad Foothills, including Giant Moss Creepers, Forest Moss Creepers, Elder Moss Creepers, and the notable arachnid Creepthess.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need this fluid?
aliases: what is creeper ichor used for
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon uses Creeper Ichor as a vital killing agent in his ongoing alchemical research to brew the Elixir of Suffering, designed to plague and exterminate the living humans in Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why is Creeper Ichor so difficult to find?
faq.answer: While moss creepers are common throughout the forests surrounding Tarren Mill, viable reservoirs of this particular virulent ichor are uncommon, requiring hunters to slay many arachnids before securing a usable specimen.

angles.text: For Forsaken loyalists, securing lethal components like Creeper Ichor directly advances the Royal Apothecary Society's campaign to scour the living from Lordaeron.
